Ursula Klein  
📍 Berlin, Germany | 📧 ur.sula.klein@gmail.com | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/ursulaklein | 🌐 ur.sula.klein.dev  

A seasoned frontend architect with 11 years of shaping scalable, high-performance digital experiences. Specialize in crafting robust architectures that balance technical excellence with business objectives. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, mentor junior engineers, and drive measurable improvements in system reliability and user engagement.  

**Professional Experience**  
Staff Frontend Engineer, NexaWave Technologies (2018–present)  
Architected and scaled the company’s flagship product, a real-time collaboration platform used by 200,000+ users. Spearheaded the transition from monolithic to microservices architecture, reducing deployment latency by 40% and increasing system uptime to 99.95%. Introduced a unified design system adopted across three product lines, standardizing UI components and reducing redundancy by 30%. Led a team of 8 engineers to implement a custom state management solution using TypeScript and Redux, improving application performance by 25% and reducing bug reports by 18%.  

Senior Frontend Engineer, Aether Labs (2015–2018)  
Reengineered the core frontend framework of a SaaS platform, migrating from Angular to React and implementing a server-side rendering strategy with Next.js. This reduced initial load times by 50% and increased user retention by 12%. Built a REST API gateway that streamlined third-party integrations, cutting API call latency by 35% and reducing maintenance overhead by 40%.  

Junior Frontend Developer, Lumos Innovations (2012–2015)  
Contributed to the development of a data visualization tool used in financial analytics, implementing dynamic charts with D3.js and optimizing rendering performance for large datasets. Collaborated with backend teams to design a scalable API structure, which later became the foundation for the company’s public API suite.  

**Projects**  
1. **NexaWave Collaboration Platform** (2019–present)  
   - Designed a custom GraphQL layer to decouple frontend from backend services, enabling real-time data synchronization across 15+ integrations.  
   - Engineered a performance optimization strategy combining Webpack 5, Vite, and lazy loading, reducing bundle size by 35% and improving Time to Interactive by 22%.  
   - Implemented a centralized state management system using Zustand, replacing multiple ad-hoc solutions and reducing state-related bugs by 60%.  

2. **Aether Labs SaaS Platform** (2016–2018)  
   - Built a modular design system with Figma and Tailwind CSS, adopted across 12 internal tools and reducing UI development time by 20%.  
   - Developed a test automation framework using Jest and Cypress, achieving 90% test coverage and cutting regression bug resolution time by 50%.  
   - Optimized critical rendering paths in React components, improving LCP scores from 3.2s to 1.8s and contributing to a 15% increase in user engagement.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **React**: Central to all frontend development, with architecture decisions influencing 10+ projects. Mentored 12 engineers in best practices and component design.  
- **Next.js**: Leveraged for server-side rendering and static generation, reducing load times and improving SEO metrics across multiple product lines.  
- **TypeScript**: Enforced type safety across all codebases, reducing runtime errors by 45% and improving code maintainability.  
- **GraphQL**: Owned the implementation of a production GraphQL API, integrating with 8+ backend services and reducing redundant data fetching by 60%.  
- **Node.js**: Built backend microservices for real-time features, handling 100k+ concurrent connections with zero downtime.  
- **REST API design**: Led API specification for 5+ integrations, ensuring alignment with business requirements and technical constraints.  
- **State management**: Developed custom solutions using Redux and Zustand, streamlining complex state flows in large-scale applications.  
- **Webpack/Vite**: Optimized build pipelines, reducing deployment times by 30% and improving developer productivity.  
- **Responsive design**: Ensured cross-device compatibility for all projects, with 95%+ of user interactions optimized for mobile-first workflows.  
- **Web performance optimization**: Championed performance improvements across 12+ projects, achieving average LCP reductions of 25% and TTI improvements of 30%.  

**Education**  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Stanford University (2012)  

**Publications**  
- *“Performance-Driven Frontend Architecture”* (2021) – A case study on optimizing large-scale React applications for NexaWave.  
- *“GraphQL in Practice: Lessons from Scaling a Monorepo”* (2020) – Published in *Frontend Focus* magazine.  

**Certifications**  
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect (2022)  
- Google Cloud Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer (2021)
